name: Alpiq Green Fund
summary: Fund of the Ruppoldingen hydropower plant for habitat and river revitalisation projects in Switzerland, mainly water-related, such as ponds, streams and floodplains. Regional projects take priority.

calls.label: Mid-April and mid-October submission dates
calls.recurring: Applications due by mid-April and by mid-October each year

status.quote: Applications should be submitted no later than by mid-April (for the May meeting) or mid-October (for the November meeting).

recurring.quote: Applications should be submitted no later than by mid-April (for the May meeting) or mid-October (for the November meeting).

geography.quote: In the meantime, the perimeter has been expanded to the whole of Switzerland, but regional projects still take priority.

access.quote: It is mandatory to fill out the application form. The easiest and best way to do this is online.
